notes: DiscoFlate v3.49.0 — overlays get a real editor. NEW 🅣 TEXT overlay (colour, size, font, optional background, live [capacity]/[secs]), and every overlay now carries its own options saved per stage: the Pump Timer gets the same text styling plus editable pumping/idle formats, and the Capacity Gauge gets fill colour, thickness, horizontal OR vertical orientation and a show-% toggle. All overlays support ROTATION (⟳ handle, Shift snaps to 15°, ↺ resets) and FLASH (N seconds visible, N hidden). Canvas now has proper 8-POINT RESIZE — four corners plus four edges, anchored to the opposite side, with media gaining an optional explicit height (blank = keep aspect). ISOLATE FIX: broadcasts now really do pin to one channel across all servers — the announce channel no longer leaks output into another server, and the bot keeps listening everywhere so commands still work. CAMERA FIXES: browsers rejected our RGB frames from v4l2loopback (the 'loading forever then error 2014' hang) — Linux now feeds I420 like OBS does; a 🪞 Mirror toggle cancels Discord's un-disableable self-view mirror (off by default so viewers get the true image); and 🩺 Driver checks for the virtual-camera driver and installs it for you. The phone Stage view is parked — the PC is the camera home base.
